name: LAUNCH Wheel Alignment Tool Trolley
summary: Mobile LAUNCH workshop tool trolley with three drawers and a worktop, used to keep wheel alignment clamps, accessories and hand tools organised beside the alignment bay.

name: UNITE Metal Sheet Repair Machine
summary: Trolley-mounted body repair station (dent puller / stud welder) with a digital control panel, cable and slide-hammer pulling tools, for repairing dents in vehicle sheet-metal panels.

name: GTI.tools Wheel Balancer Digital Plus
summary: Computerised wheel balancer with a digital LCD display, wheel guard hood and accessory tray, for balancing passenger car and light commercial vehicle wheels in tyre shops and service workshops.

name: GTI.tools Sticker Weight
summary: Self-adhesive wheel balancing weights supplied in segmented strips, for alloy wheels where clip-on weights cannot be fitted. Segments are separated to match the correction the wheel balancer calls for.

name: GTI.tools Clip Weight
summary: Clip-on (hammer-on) wheel balancing weights in a range of sizes, fitted to the rim flange of steel and compatible alloy wheels during wheel balancing.

name: GTI.tools Catalytic & DPF Cleaner (C2025 AI)
summary: Catalytic converter and diesel particulate filter (DPF) cleaning and regeneration machine with a touch-screen control panel on a mobile cabinet, for workshops servicing exhaust after-treatment systems.

name: GTI.tools Catalytic & DPF Cleaner (HHO Power X)
summary: HHO (oxyhydrogen) carbon-cleaning machine for catalytic converter and DPF cleaning, with a front control panel and a mobile cabinet on castors.
portfolio_title: GTI.tools Catalytic & DPF Cleaner (HHO Power X)

name: GTI.tools Frame Aligner
summary: Collision-repair frame straightening bench with pulling towers, chains, vehicle clamps, drive-on ramps and hydraulic pump units, for correcting chassis and body damage after an accident.
